title: Кількість
rule: Many — зі злічуваними (many bugs), much — з незлічуваними (much time); a few/a little — «трохи» (позитивно), few/little — «майже немає» (негативно). Some — у ствердженнях, any — у запитаннях і запереченнях. Незлічувані (advice, information, feedback, equipment, news) не мають множини й не вживаються з a/an.

items.prompt: How ___ people work in your team?
I do not have ___ time today.
There is ___ milk in the fridge, so I can make coffee.
items.explanation: Milk незлічуване, а «трохи є» → a little.

items.prompt: I have ___ friends in Warsaw, so I often feel lonely.
Could you give me ___ advice about my CV?
The news ___ really good today.
items.explanation: News незлічуване й вживається з is.

items.prompt: Do you have ___ questions?
items.explanation: У запитаннях зазвичай any, а questions злічуване (every + множина неможливе).

items.prompt: I did not get ___ feedback from the reviewer.
We need some new ___ for the office.
There is hardly ___ documentation for this API.
There are not ___ chairs in the room. (much/many)
How ___ money do you need? (much/many)
I would like ___ water, please. (some/any)
Can I ask you ___ questions? (a little/a few)
He has made very ___ progress this month. (little/few)
items.explanation: Progress незлічуване, а very… з негативним сенсом → little.

items.prompt: Every developer in the team ___ a laptop. (have)
She gave me many good advices.
answers: She gave me a lot of good advice.
She gave me some good advice.
She gave me lots of good advice.
She gave me a lot of useful advice.
items.explanation: Advice незлічуване — без множини й без many.

items.prompt: The information are on our website.
answers: The information is on our website.

items.prompt: We need more equipments for testing.
answers: We need more equipment for testing.

items.prompt: I have less bugs than last week.
answers: I have fewer bugs than last week.
items.explanation: Зі злічуваними — fewer, а не less.
